popup_migrationBanner.message: Open YouTube once to complete the initial sync.

popup_watchedThresholdHelp.message: 1-100% (default: 95%). Invalid or out-of-range values reset to 95%. Existing watch records are unchanged.

popup_pageVisibilityHelp.message: Videos stay visible on pages where hiding is off. Watch history is still recorded. Related videos refers to suggestions on watch pages.

popup_hideMoviesHelp.message: Hide movies and shows from video lists

popup_harvestMode.message: Show the bulk import button on the History page

popup_harvestHelp.message: Show a Harvest button on the History page. Pause thumbnail loading for fast scrolling and automatic import (remove processed page elements to prevent crashes).

popup_recordWhileOffHelp.message: Keep recording watch history while hiding is turned OFF

popup_autoBackupHelp.message: Save once a day to youtube-watched-hider-backup in your Downloads folder

popup_replaceBackup.message: Replace (restore this backup after an automatic backup)

popup_safeMerge.message: Merge safely (keep current data on conflicts)

popup_backupMerge.message: Merge with backup priority (overwrite conflicts with imported data)

popup_syncHelp.message: Import a backup from another PC and merge only the differences

popup_deleteHelp.message: Choose which data to delete. Reset all data saves an automatic backup before proceeding.

popup_clearAll.message: Reset all data (after an automatic backup)

popup_aboutStorage.message: IndexedDB: no storage limit (about 300 B per track / 3 MB per 10,000 tracks)

popup_aboutSeekBar.message: Progress bar: automatically detects YouTube's red bar

popup_aboutBackup.message: Backup: automatic daily backups / manual export

popup_aboutHistory.message: History: records titles, play counts, and detection sources

popup_aboutSyncStep1.message: Share the JSON saved by automatic backup

popup_aboutSyncStep2.message: via Dropbox or a similar service, then select Import and merge

popup_aboutSyncStep3.message: on another PC to import only the differences.

popup_supportNote.message: All features are available whether or not you donate.
